targetAudience: Engineers, editors, and authors who ship model-written drafts, slide decks, and web pages.

stanceAndPerspective.defaultPerson: Address the author in second person; refer to dislop in third person rather than corporate 'we'.
stanceAndPerspective.uncertaintyPolicy: Name every inspected part and every skipped part ([SKIP]); never mark unread input as clean.
stanceAndPerspective.evidenceRequirement: Anchor each claim to a concrete span, location, number, or command; quote author facts as written.
rhetoricalGuards: Red (error) states a direct fact and remedy; blue (warning/info) asks one question the author can answer.
Describe the text or layout span, never the writer or the model.
Allow at most one dry, playful beat per surface, only in neutral or resolved states, never inside an error or rejection.
Delete the wink: the sentence must still carry a concrete fact.
Write English and Chinese independently from meaning; keep English in Chinese copy only for literal identifiers.

positiveSkeletons.name: Quote, reason, question
sequence: State what it costs the reader
Ask one question the author can answer

positiveSkeletons.name: What changed, how to use it, what is still out of reach
sequence: State what dislop now catches or checks
Show the minimal command or entry point
Name what remains out of reach or skipped

positiveExemplars.text: This opener makes the reader wait. Cut everything up to "that". Does the sentence still say it all?
还读不了的：加密 PDF，以及 CID 编码的 PDF 正文。这两种都会如实记为跳过。

forbidCaricaturePatterns: Emoji, exclamation marks, or mascot chatter standing in for warmth
More than one proofreading pun on a page
Contempt or snark aimed at AI, models, or the author
Repeating 'zero' or '零' as an intensifier across the same screen
